units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 5. Persons holding state offices of the Russian Federation, state offices of constituent entities of the Russian Federation or municipal offices who violate the prohibitions, restrictions or duties established by parts 1–4.1-1 of this Article shall incur the liability provided for by federal constitutional laws, federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation, except where those prohibitions, restrictions or duties were violated as a consequence of circumstances beyond their control recognized as such under parts 3–6 of Article 13 of this Federal Law, unless otherwise provided for by federal constitutional laws or federal laws.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 6. Persons holding state offices of the Russian Federation, state offices of constituent entities of the Russian Federation or municipal offices who are employer’s representatives (heads) may not, in order to avoid a conflict of interest in a state body or local self-government body, represent the interests of state or municipal servants in the elected trade union body of the relevant body during the period in which they exercise the powers of those offices.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.2. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Employees Holding Certain Positions under Employment Contracts in Organizations Established to Carry Out Tasks Assigned to Federal State Bodies
units.text: Article 12.2. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Employees Holding Certain Positions under Employment Contracts in Organizations Established to Carry Out Tasks Assigned to Federal State Bodies
units.label: Art. 12.2

units.locator: Article 12.2. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Employees Holding Certain Positions under Employment Contracts in Organizations Established to Carry Out Tasks Assigned to Federal State Bodies
units.text: Unless otherwise established by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation, employees holding certain positions under employment contracts in organizations established to carry out tasks assigned to federal state bodies shall be subject to the restrictions, prohibitions and duties established for federal state servants serving in the relevant federal state bodies, according to the procedure provided for by regulatory legal acts of federal state bodies.
units.label: Art. 12.2 · text

units.locator: Article 12.3. Duty to Transfer Securities (Participation Interests or Shares in the Charter (Pooled) Capitals of Organizations) into Trust Management to Prevent Conflicts of Interest
units.text: Article 12.3. Duty to Transfer Securities (Participation Interests or Shares in the Charter (Pooled) Capitals of Organizations) into Trust Management to Prevent Conflicts of Interest
units.label: Art. 12.3

units.locator: Article 12.3. Duty to Transfer Securities (Participation Interests or Shares in the Charter (Pooled) Capitals of Organizations) into Trust Management to Prevent Conflicts of Interest
units.text: 1. If ownership of securities (participation interests or shares in the charter (pooled) capitals of organizations) by a person holding a state office of the Russian Federation, a state office of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, a municipal office, a state service position, a municipal service position, a position in a state corporation (company), a public-law company, a state extrabudgetary fund of the Russian Federation or another organization established by the Russian Federation under a federal law, or a position under an employment contract in an organization established to carry out tasks assigned to federal state bodies, leads or may lead to a conflict of interest, that person shall transfer the securities (participation interests or shares in the charter (pooled) capitals of organizations) belonging to that person into trust management in accordance with the civil legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 12.3

units.locator: Article 12.3. Duty to Transfer Securities (Participation Interests or Shares in the Charter (Pooled) Capitals of Organizations) into Trust Management to Prevent Conflicts of Interest
units.text: 2. The requirements of part 1 of this Article apply to employees of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation holding positions included in the list approved by the Board of Directors of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 12.3

units.locator: Article 12.3. Duty to Transfer Securities (Participation Interests or Shares in the Charter (Pooled) Capitals of Organizations) into Trust Management to Prevent Conflicts of Interest
units.text: 3. The requirements of part 1 of this Article apply to persons holding the positions of Financial Ombudsman or head of the service supporting the activities of the Financial Ombudsman.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 12.3

units.locator: Article 12.4. Restrictions, Prohibitions and Duties Imposed on Employees Holding Positions in State Corporations (Companies), Public-Law Companies, State Extrabudgetary Funds of the Russian Federation and Other Organizations Established by the Russian Federation under Federal Laws, and on Employees Holding Certain Positions under Employment Contracts in Organizations Established to Carry Out Tasks Assigned to Federal State Bodies
units.text: Article 12.4. Restrictions, Prohibitions and Duties Imposed on Employees Holding Positions in State Corporations (Companies), Public-Law Companies, State Extrabudgetary Funds of the Russian Federation and Other Organizations Established by the Russian Federation under Federal Laws, and on Employees Holding Certain Positions under Employment Contracts in Organizations Established to Carry Out Tasks Assigned to Federal State Bodies
units.label: Art. 12.4

units.locator: Article 12.4. Restrictions, Prohibitions and Duties Imposed on Employees Holding Positions in State Corporations (Companies), Public-Law Companies, State Extrabudgetary Funds of the Russian Federation and Other Organizations Established by the Russian Federation under Federal Laws, and on Employees Holding Certain Positions under Employment Contracts in Organizations Established to Carry Out Tasks Assigned to Federal State Bodies
units.text: Employees holding positions in state corporations (companies), public-law companies, state extrabudgetary funds of the Russian Federation and other organizations established by the Russian Federation under federal laws, and employees holding certain positions under employment contracts in organizations established to carry out tasks assigned to federal state bodies, shall, according to the procedure determined by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation and taking into account the specific features arising from their legal status, be subject to the restrictions, prohibitions and duties established for persons holding federal state service positions by this Federal Law and by point 5 of part 1 of Article 16 and Articles 17, 18, 20 and 20.1 of Federal Law No. 79-ФЗ of 27 July 2004 “On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation”.
units.label: Art. 12.4 · text

units.locator: Article 12.5. Establishment of Other Prohibitions, Restrictions, Obligations and Rules of Official Conduct
units.text: Article 12.5. Establishment of Other Prohibitions, Restrictions, Obligations and Rules of Official Conduct
units.label: Art. 12.5

units.locator: Article 12.5. Establishment of Other Prohibitions, Restrictions, Obligations and Rules of Official Conduct
units.text: 1. Federal constitutional laws, federal laws, laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and municipal regulatory legal acts may, for the purpose of combating corruption, establish other prohibitions, restrictions, obligations and rules of official conduct for persons holding state offices of the Russian Federation, state offices of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, municipal offices, state service positions, municipal service positions, positions in state corporations (companies), public-law companies, state extrabudgetary funds of the Russian Federation or other organizations established by the Russian Federation under federal laws, or certain positions under employment contracts in organizations established to carry out tasks assigned to federal state bodies.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 12.5

units.locator: Article 12.5. Establishment of Other Prohibitions, Restrictions, Obligations and Rules of Official Conduct
units.text: 2. The provisions of part 1 of this Article apply to employees of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation holding positions included in the list approved by the Board of Directors of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 12.5

units.locator: Article 12.5. Establishment of Other Prohibitions, Restrictions, Obligations and Rules of Official Conduct
units.text: 3. The requirements of part 1 of this Article apply to persons holding the positions of Financial Ombudsman or head of the service supporting the activities of the Financial Ombudsman.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 12.5

units.locator: Article 13. Liability of Individuals for Corruption Offenses
units.text: Article 13. Liability of Individuals for Corruption Offenses
units.label: Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Liability of Individuals for Corruption Offenses
units.text: 1. Citizens of the Russian Federation, foreign citizens and stateless persons shall bear criminal, administrative, civil-law and disciplinary liability for committing corruption offenses in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Liability of Individuals for Corruption Offenses
units.text: 2. An individual who has committed a corruption offense may, by a court decision and in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation, be deprived of the right to hold certain state and municipal service positions.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Liability of Individuals for Corruption Offenses
units.text: 3. An individual for whom this Federal Law and other federal laws establish, for the purpose of combating corruption, disciplinary liability for noncompliance with restrictions, prohibitions or requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, or for failure to perform duties, shall be exempt from that liability if such noncompliance or failure is recognized, according to the procedure provided for in this Article, as a consequence of circumstances beyond that individual’s control. The individual shall ensure compliance with such restrictions, prohibitions and requirements and performance of such duties no later than one month after the circumstances beyond that individual’s control that impeded compliance with such restrictions, prohibitions and requirements and performance of such duties cease to apply, unless otherwise established by federal laws.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Liability of Individuals for Corruption Offenses
units.text: 4. For the purposes of this Federal Law, circumstances beyond an individual’s control are extraordinary and unavoidable circumstances outside the control of the individual affected by them which, under the given conditions, could not have been expected or avoided or could not have been overcome, and which preclude compliance with restrictions, prohibitions or requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest or performance of duties established by this Federal Law and other federal laws for the purpose of combating corruption. Such circumstances include, in particular, natural disasters (including earthquakes, floods and hurricanes), fire, mass diseases (epidemics), strikes, hostilities, terrorist acts, and prohibitive or restrictive measures adopted by state bodies (including state bodies of foreign states) or local self-government bodies. Regularly recurring and predictable events and phenomena, and circumstances whose occurrence depended on the will or actions of the individual invoking them, may not be recognized as circumstances beyond an individual’s control.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Liability of Individuals for Corruption Offenses
units.text: 5. Recognition of circumstances beyond an individual’s control as grounds for exempting that individual from disciplinary liability for noncompliance with restrictions, prohibitions or requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, or for failure to perform duties established by this Federal Law and other federal laws for the purpose of combating corruption, is conditional on the commission on compliance with requirements for the official conduct of state or municipal servants and the resolution of conflicts of interest (or another collegial body performing the functions of that commission) establishing a causal link between the occurrence of those circumstances and the impossibility of compliance with such restrictions, prohibitions and requirements and performance of such duties.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Liability of Individuals for Corruption Offenses
units.text: 6. An individual specified in part 3 of this Article shall, within three working days after learning of the occurrence of circumstances beyond their control that impede compliance with restrictions, prohibitions or requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, or performance of duties established by this Federal Law and other federal laws for the purpose of combating corruption, submit notification of this to the relevant commission on compliance with requirements for the official conduct of state or municipal servants and the resolution of conflicts of interest (or another collegial body performing the functions of that commission), in paper or electronic document form, attaching documents, other materials and/or information (if available) confirming the occurrence of circumstances beyond their control. If those circumstances prevent submission of the notification within the established period, the notification shall be submitted no later than 10 working days after those circumstances cease.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13.1. Dismissal (Removal from Office) of Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation or Municipal Offices Due to Loss of Trust
units.text: Article 13.1. Dismissal (Removal from Office) of Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation or Municipal Offices Due to Loss of Trust
units.label: Art. 13.1

units.locator: Article 13.1. Dismissal (Removal from Office) of Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation or Municipal Offices Due to Loss of Trust
units.text: 1. A person holding a state office of the Russian Federation, a state office of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation or a municipal office shall be dismissed (removed from office) due to loss of trust, according to the procedure provided for by federal constitutional laws, federal laws, laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and municipal regulatory legal acts, in the event of:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 13.1

units.locator: Article 13.1. Dismissal (Removal from Office) of Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation or Municipal Offices Due to Loss of Trust
units.text: 1) the person’s failure to take measures to prevent and/or resolve a conflict of interest to which that person is a party, except in cases established by federal laws;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 13.1

units.locator: Article 13.1. Dismissal (Removal from Office) of Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation or Municipal Offices Due to Loss of Trust
units.text: 2) the person’s failure to submit information on income, property and property-related obligations provided for by this Federal Law, submission of knowingly incomplete information, except in cases established by federal laws, or submission of knowingly inaccurate information, unless otherwise established by federal laws;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 13.1

units.locator: Article 13.1. Dismissal (Removal from Office) of Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation or Municipal Offices Due to Loss of Trust
units.text: 3) the person’s paid participation in the activities of a commercial organization’s management body, except in cases established by federal law;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 13.1

units.locator: Article 13.1. Dismissal (Removal from Office) of Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation or Municipal Offices Due to Loss of Trust
units.text: 4) the person’s engagement in entrepreneurial activity;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 13.1

units.locator: Article 13.1. Dismissal (Removal from Office) of Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation or Municipal Offices Due to Loss of Trust
units.text: 5) the person’s membership of management bodies, boards of trustees or supervisory boards, or other bodies of foreign nonprofit nongovernmental organizations or their structural subdivisions operating in the territory of the Russian Federation, unless otherwise provided for by an international treaty of the Russian Federation or the legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 13.1

units.locator: Article 13.1. Dismissal (Removal from Office) of Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation or Municipal Offices Due to Loss of Trust
units.text: 2. A person holding a state office of the Russian Federation, a state office of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation or a municipal office who becomes aware that a subordinate has a personal interest that leads or may lead to a conflict of interest shall also be dismissed (removed from office) due to loss of trust if the person holding the state office of the Russian Federation, state office of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation or municipal office fails to take measures to prevent and/or resolve the conflict of interest to which the subordinate is a party, except in cases established by federal laws.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 13.1

units.locator: Article 13.1. Dismissal (Removal from Office) of Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation or Municipal Offices Due to Loss of Trust
units.text: 3. Information on the imposition, on a person holding a state office of the Russian Federation, a state office of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation or a municipal office, of a penalty in the form of dismissal (removal from office) due to loss of trust for committing a corruption offense shall be entered by the state body (local self-government body) in which that person held the relevant office into the register of persons dismissed due to loss of trust provided for in Article 15 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 13.1

units.locator: Article 13.1. Dismissal (Removal from Office) of Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation or Municipal Offices Due to Loss of Trust
units.text: Article 13.2. Dismissal (Removal from Office) Due to Loss of Trust of Persons Holding Positions in the Central Bank of the Russian Federation, State Corporations (Companies), Public-Law Companies, State Extrabudgetary Funds of the Russian Federation, Other Organizations Established by the Russian Federation under Federal Laws, Organizations Established to Carry Out Tasks Assigned to Federal State Bodies, or the Positions of Financial Ombudsman or Head of the Service Supporting the Activities of the Financial Ombudsman
units.label: Part 3 Art. 13.1 · “Article 13.2. Dismissal (Removal from Office) Due to Loss of…”

units.locator: Article 13.1. Dismissal (Removal from Office) of Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation or Municipal Offices Due to Loss of Trust
units.text: 1. Persons holding positions in the Central Bank of the Russian Federation, persons holding positions in state corporations (companies), public-law companies, state extrabudgetary funds of the Russian Federation or other organizations established by the Russian Federation under federal laws, or certain positions under employment contracts in organizations established to carry out tasks assigned to federal state bodies, and persons holding the positions of Financial Ombudsman or head of the service supporting the activities of the Financial Ombudsman shall be dismissed (removed from office) due to loss of trust in cases provided for by federal laws.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 13.1

units.locator: Article 13.1. Dismissal (Removal from Office) of Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation or Municipal Offices Due to Loss of Trust
units.text: 2. Information on the imposition, on a person holding a position in the Central Bank of the Russian Federation, or a person holding a position in a state corporation (company), a public-law company, a state extrabudgetary fund of the Russian Federation or another organization established by the Russian Federation under a federal law, or a certain position under an employment contract in an organization established to carry out tasks assigned to a federal state body, of a penalty in the form of dismissal (removal from office) due to loss of trust shall be entered, respectively, by the Central Bank of the Russian Federation, the state corporation (company), the public-law company, the state extrabudgetary fund of the Russian Federation, the other organization established by the Russian Federation under a federal law or the federal state body into the register of persons dismissed due to loss of trust provided for in Article 15 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 13.1

units.locator: Article 13.3. Duty of Organizations to Take Corruption Prevention Measures
units.text: Article 13.3. Duty of Organizations to Take Corruption Prevention Measures
units.label: Art. 13.3

units.locator: Article 13.3. Duty of Organizations to Take Corruption Prevention Measures
units.text: 1. Organizations shall develop and adopt corruption prevention measures.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 13.3

units.locator: Article 13.3. Duty of Organizations to Take Corruption Prevention Measures
units.text: 2. Corruption prevention measures adopted in an organization may include:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 13.3

units.locator: Article 13.3. Duty of Organizations to Take Corruption Prevention Measures
units.text: 1) designating units or officials responsible for preventing corruption and other offenses;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 13.3

units.locator: Article 13.3. Duty of Organizations to Take Corruption Prevention Measures
units.text: 2) the organization’s cooperation with law enforcement bodies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 13.3

units.locator: Article 13.3. Duty of Organizations to Take Corruption Prevention Measures
units.text: 3) developing and implementing standards and procedures aimed at ensuring the organization’s good-faith operation;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 13.3

units.locator: Article 13.3. Duty of Organizations to Take Corruption Prevention Measures
units.text: 4) adopting a code of ethics and official conduct for the organization’s employees;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 13.3

units.locator: Article 13.3. Duty of Organizations to Take Corruption Prevention Measures
units.text: 5) preventing and resolving conflicts of interest;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 13.3

units.locator: Article 13.3. Duty of Organizations to Take Corruption Prevention Measures
units.text: 6) preventing the preparation of unofficial reports and the use of forged documents.
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 13.3

units.locator: Article 13.4. Verifications Conducted by an Authorized Unit of the Executive Office of the President of the Russian Federation
units.text: Article 13.4. Verifications Conducted by an Authorized Unit of the Executive Office of the President of the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 13.4

units.locator: Article 13.4. Verifications Conducted by an Authorized Unit of the Executive Office of the President of the Russian Federation
units.text: 1. By decision of the President of the Russian Federation, the Chief of Staff of the Executive Office of the President of the Russian Federation, or an official of the Executive Office of the President of the Russian Federation specifically authorized by them, an authorized unit of the Executive Office of the President of the Russian Federation may, according to the established procedure, verify:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 13.4

units.locator: Article 13.4. Verifications Conducted by an Authorized Unit of the Executive Office of the President of the Russian Federation
units.text: 1) the accuracy and completeness of information on income, expenditure, property and property-related obligations submitted by citizens seeking to hold any positions the exercise of whose powers entails a duty to submit the information on income, property and property-related obligations provided for by this Federal Law and the information on expenditure provided for by Federal Law No. 230-ФЗ of 3 December 2012 “On Monitoring the Correspondence between the Expenditure of Persons Holding State Offices and Other Persons and Their Income”, and of other information submitted by those citizens in accordance with regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 13.4

units.locator: Article 13.4. Verifications Conducted by an Authorized Unit of the Executive Office of the President of the Russian Federation
units.text: 2) the accuracy and completeness of information on income, expenditure, property and property-related obligations submitted by persons holding positions provided for in point 1 of this part;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 13.4

units.locator: Article 13.4. Verifications Conducted by an Authorized Unit of the Executive Office of the President of the Russian Federation
units.text: 3) compliance by persons holding positions provided for in points 1 and 1.1 of part 1 of Article 7.1 of this Federal Law, their spouses and minor children with the prohibitions and restrictions established for them, and performance by persons holding positions provided for in points 1 and 1.1 of part 1 of Article 7.1 of this Federal Law of their duties under anticorruption legislation.
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 13.4

units.locator: Article 13.4. Verifications Conducted by an Authorized Unit of the Executive Office of the President of the Russian Federation
units.text: 2. Verifications provided for in part 1 of this Article may be conducted independently of verifications conducted by units, officials or commissions of other bodies and organizations.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 13.4

units.locator: Article 13.5. Verifications in the Event of Dismissal (Termination of Powers) of Certain Categories of Persons
units.text: Article 13.5. Verifications in the Event of Dismissal (Termination of Powers) of Certain Categories of Persons
units.label: Art. 13.5

units.locator: Article 13.5. Verifications in the Event of Dismissal (Termination of Powers) of Certain Categories of Persons
units.text: 1. Where a person who was subject to restrictions, prohibitions, requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest and/or duties established for the purpose of combating corruption, and in respect of whom a decision had been taken to verify the accuracy and completeness of the information on income, property and property-related obligations submitted by that person and/or compliance with restrictions, prohibitions or requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest and/or performance of duties established for the purpose of combating corruption, is dismissed (has their powers terminated) after completion of that verification and before a decision is taken to impose a penalty on that person for a corruption offense committed, a report on the impossibility of holding that person under verification liable for the corruption offense shall be submitted to the person who decided to conduct that verification.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 13.5

units.locator: Article 13.5. Verifications in the Event of Dismissal (Termination of Powers) of Certain Categories of Persons
units.text: 2. Where a person who was subject to restrictions, prohibitions, requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest and/or duties established for the purpose of combating corruption, and in respect of whom a decision had been taken to verify the accuracy and completeness of the information on income, property and property-related obligations submitted by that person and/or compliance with restrictions, prohibitions or requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest and/or performance of duties established for the purpose of combating corruption, is dismissed (has their powers terminated) during that verification, a report on the impossibility of completing the verification in respect of that person under verification shall be submitted to the person who decided to conduct that verification.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 13.5

units.locator: Article 13.5. Verifications in the Event of Dismissal (Termination of Powers) of Certain Categories of Persons
units.text: 3. In the cases provided for in parts 1 and 2 of this Article, the materials obtained, respectively, after completion of the verification provided for in parts 1 and 2 of this Article and during its conduct shall, within three days after the dismissal (termination of powers) of the person under verification specified in parts 1 and 2 of this Article, be forwarded by the person who decided to conduct that verification to the prosecution bodies of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 13.5

units.locator: Article 13.5. Verifications in the Event of Dismissal (Termination of Powers) of Certain Categories of Persons
units.text: 4. No later than ten working days after receipt of the materials specified in part 3 of this Article concerning the person under verification specified in part 2 of this Article, the Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation or subordinate prosecutors shall decide to verify the accuracy and completeness of the information on income, property and property-related obligations submitted by that person and/or compliance with restrictions, prohibitions or requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest and/or performance of duties established for the purpose of combating corruption. That decision shall be made in writing separately in respect of each person under verification.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 13.5

units.locator: Article 13.5. Verifications in the Event of Dismissal (Termination of Powers) of Certain Categories of Persons
units.text: 5. The Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation or subordinate prosecutors shall, no later than two working days after taking the decision specified in part 4 of this Article, notify the person under verification specified in part 2 of this Article in writing of the decision taken in respect of that person.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 13.5

units.locator: Article 13.5. Verifications in the Event of Dismissal (Termination of Powers) of Certain Categories of Persons
units.text: 6. The verification specified in part 4 of this Article shall be conducted by prosecutors.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 13.5

units.locator: Article 13.5. Verifications in the Event of Dismissal (Termination of Powers) of Certain Categories of Persons
units.text: 7. The verification specified in part 4 of this Article may not be conducted after six months have elapsed from the date of dismissal (termination of powers) of the person under verification specified in part 2 of this Article.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 13.5

units.locator: Article 13.5. Verifications in the Event of Dismissal (Termination of Powers) of Certain Categories of Persons
units.text: 8. During the verification specified in part 4 of this Article, the person under verification specified in part 2 of this Article is entitled to:
units.label: Part 8 Art. 13.5

units.locator: Article 13.5. Verifications in the Event of Dismissal (Termination of Powers) of Certain Categories of Persons
units.text: 1) provide written explanations concerning the information on income, property and property-related obligations submitted by that person whose accuracy and completeness are being verified, and concerning the materials under verification relating to compliance with restrictions, prohibitions or requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest and/or performance of duties established for the purpose of combating corruption;
units.label: Point 1 Part 8 Art. 13.5

units.locator: Article 13.5. Verifications in the Event of Dismissal (Termination of Powers) of Certain Categories of Persons
units.text: 2) submit additional materials and provide written explanations concerning them;
units.label: Point 2 Part 8 Art. 13.5

units.locator: Article 13.5. Verifications in the Event of Dismissal (Termination of Powers) of Certain Categories of Persons
units.text: 3) petition the prosecutor for an interview on matters relating to the conduct of the verification. The petition must be granted.
units.label: Point 3 Part 8 Art. 13.5

units.locator: Article 13.5. Verifications in the Event of Dismissal (Termination of Powers) of Certain Categories of Persons
units.text: 9. During the verification specified in part 4 of this Article, the person under verification specified in part 2 of this Article shall, within three working days after receiving the notification provided for in part 5 of this Article, submit to the prosecutor information on their current place of employment (service) and position held.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 13.5

units.locator: Article 13.5. Verifications in the Event of Dismissal (Termination of Powers) of Certain Categories of Persons
units.text: 10. When conducting the verification specified in part 4 of this Article, the Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation or subordinate prosecutors shall:
units.label: Part 10 Art. 13.5

units.locator: Article 13.5. Verifications in the Event of Dismissal (Termination of Powers) of Certain Categories of Persons
units.text: 1) examine additional materials submitted by the person under verification specified in part 2 of this Article;
units.label: Point 1 Part 10 Art. 13.5

units.locator: Article 13.5. Verifications in the Event of Dismissal (Termination of Powers) of Certain Categories of Persons
units.text: 2) conduct an interview with the person under verification specified in part 2 of this Article if the petition provided for in point 3 of part 8 of this Article is received.
units.label: Point 2 Part 10 Art. 13.5
